# XingAI

Primary URL: https://xingai.app

XingAI builds focused AI decision systems for everyday life and research.
It is not a generic chatbot. Each product is built around one decision
and a clear next action.

Flagship public surface: the Invest AI Industry Map
https://invest.xingai.app/ai-map

The map is a cache-rendered research view of AI supply-chain layers and
cited public filings. It is not a broker, allocation board, or trade signal.

How XingAI works: https://xingai.app/story
- XingAI is a system that turns ideas into continuously operating AI products.
- Idea Vault (memory): a private, owner-only workspace that gives each idea a
  permanent number and keeps its research, decisions and history. Available today
  at https://vault.xingai.app (login required).
- Orchestrator and specialized agents (execution): planned, not built yet.
- Apps (products): the catalog below, grouped as Everyday, Learning, Investing,
  and Research & ventures.
- Evidence Engine, Growth Monitor, Ops Status (trust and feedback): running as
  separate demos and internal tools. Feeding their results back into the Vault
  is planned.

Team: https://xingai.app/team
- Co-founders: Xing and Allen (real people, AI architects).
- Four AI agent roles describe how we work: Second Master (research and
  evidence), Joker (challenge and counter-evidence), Lady Bull (verification,
  "no citation, no claim"), Sweetie (user context and next action).
- These roles are characters, not employees. A person makes the final
  decision. Running the agents together as one system is planned, not built.

Services (work with XingAI): https://xingai.app/services
- Custom AI decision system: we map one recurring decision your team makes
  into a focused system, built on the same platform as our own products.
- Agent Security Assessment: a 1-2 week, read-only review of AI agents, MCP
  servers and tool permissions.
  https://xingai.app/services/agent-security-assessment
- Engineering practice workshop: ADRs, LLM evaluation, MCP in production.

Decision Agent:
- Product page: https://xingai.app/apps/decision-agent
- Official app: https://decision.xingai.app
- Purpose: turn an investment outcome into a structured brief projected
  from Invest AI’s public AI-map worker cache, then stop at human confirmation.
- Boundary: informational only. No invented allocations, broker connection,
  or autonomous trading.
